headline: Pague Menos Posts Third-Quarter Revenue Slowdown Amid Margin Gains
summary: Pague Menos reported third-quarter revenue growth of 6.9%, slowing from previous periods and missing consensus estimates. However, the pharmacy chain compensated with improved profitability, achieving its highest profit margin for the period in company history.
why: Retail pharmacy chains offer insight into domestic consumer spending resilience, retail inflation passing power, and operational efficiency trends in emerging markets.

impacts.name: Pague Menos
impacts.why: The company reported third-quarter revenue below consensus alongside record profit margins and EBITDA gains.
